rules.name: Aquan_Prime---Artillery_Attacks
rules.description: All Aquan Artillery Attacks use the Barrage and Scatter MARs with 4D6 Attack Dice.

rules.name: Aquan_Prime---Sky_Drop_Capability
rules.description: Initial Sky Drop Markers are set to 4. Initial Artillery Drop Site Markers are set to 6.

rules.name: Aquan_Prime---Tactical_Bonus
rules.description: Aquan forces have a Tactics Bonus of +2.

rules.name: Aquan_Prime---Logistical_Strength
rules.description:
Aquan Prime Forces may elect to spend Logistics Points during the Play TACs Step of the Pre-Turn Phase to place Squadrons on Overwatch:
• It costs 1 Logistics Point to place a Light Squadron on Overwatch.
• It costs 2 Logistics Points to place an Armoured Squadron on Overwatch, unless it is a Heavy Armoured Squadron (identified as having the word Heavy in its designation) or Leviathan Squadron (identified as having the word Leviathan in its designation) which cost 3 Logistics Points to place on Overwatch.
• Aerial Forces may NOT use Logistics Points to be placed on Overwatch unless specifically noted.
• In the case of mixed Squadrons (A Squadron made up of Light and Armoured Elements for example) use the largest Logistics Cost.

rules.name: Instructions
rules.description:
****** REMOVE THIS SELECTION BEFORE PRINTING ******

Natural Allies will appropriately be removed from the roster, but Allied forces require the appropriate "Select if a x or y Helix is taken as an Allied Helix" to be added in order to calculate.

****** NOVEMBER 26th ORBAT ******

The Infantry from the Nov 26th ORBAT have been added in combination with the infantry from the Sept 1st ORBAT so you can choose which stats to use until one is made official.

sharedRules.name: Aerial_Assault
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may fire its Main Ordnance while moving Flat Out provided the target squadron are Flying models – These shots are considered to be Rushed.

sharedRules.name: Bulky(2)
sharedRules.description: These units take up 2 slots in transports.

sharedRules.name: Command_Centre
sharedRules.description: A Force that contains a Malani Command Barge may take an ADDITIONAL Tactical Action Card over and above the number stated for the game size. In addition no friendly Aquan forces within the Malani’s Command Radius are required to take Disorder Tests due to the loss of their own Command Element

sharedRules.name: Command_Element(12")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 12" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Command_Element(16")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 16" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Command_Element(8")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 8" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Crystal_Formation
sharedRules.description: May be targeted by friendly Laser weapons. Will redirect this fire to an enemy target within the Mirror Crystal's range. This redirected shot cannot benefit from weapon MARs such as Pinpoint.

sharedRules.name: Crystal_Resonance
sharedRules.description: If a Malani Command Barge is deployed on the battlefield, all friendly Votari Crystals increase their range to 30” and any attacks they execute are ALWAYS considered to be Placed

sharedRules.name: Dogfighter
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may ignore the Sectored Armour MAR when targeting Flying models. Flying Target models may therefore suffer Flanking or Rear penalties to their Damage Rating when attacked by a Dogfighter!

sharedRules.name: Fearless
sharedRules.description: Unit never takes Disordered Tests.

sharedRules.name: Flying_Vehicle
sharedRules.description: When moving at Cruising Speed the unit gains Hard Target (-1), when moving at Flat Out the unit gains Hard Target (-2).

sharedRules.name: Focused_Horror
sharedRules.description: If BOTH Solar Titan Lasers fire at the same target squadron, the weapons gain the Terror Weapon MAR in addition to any other effects. This Attack may NOT be combined with other weapons on the Leviathan.

sharedRules.name: Ground_Attack
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may fire its Main Ordnance while moving Flat Out provided the target squadron are Surface models – These shots are considered to be Rushed.

sharedRules.name: Hard_Target(-1)
sharedRules.description: Main Ordnance is -1 to hit this unit.

sharedRules.name: Hard_Target(-2)
sharedRules.description: Main Ordnance is -2 to hit this unit.

sharedRules.name: Hardened_Shell
sharedRules.description: All un-Damaged Aquan Armoured and Leviathan elements are considered to have the Sectored Armour MAR. Any Aquan Armoured and Leviathan element with a Damage Marker loses its Hardened Shell rule and the Sectored Armour MAR no longer applies.

sharedRules.name: Hit_&_Run
sharedRules.description: May shoot and move OR move and move. May not move Flat Out if this rule is used. When shooting then moving, the unit cannot take advantage of Target Locks or Specialist Fire Orders such as Overwatch or Focused Fire.

sharedRules.name: Hover_Vehicle
sharedRules.description: Vehicles with this MAR is treated as Hard Target (-1) when fired at with weapons in Long Range. This does not combine with other Hard Target rules.

sharedRules.name: Hunting_Pack
sharedRules.description: If BOTH members of the Squadron manage to engage in Leviathan CQB against the same foe, increase the Pinpoint Value MAR of their Leviathan CQB attack to 4.

sharedRules.name: Independent_Targeting
sharedRules.description: May target any target in range regardless of what the rest of the Squadron targets.

sharedRules.name: Logistics_Points
sharedRules.description: May use up to 4 points to bid on an Opposed Tactics test.

sharedRules.name: Rear_Echelon
sharedRules.description: A model with this MAR is considered to be activated on the turn it is deployed.

sharedRules.name: Recon_Specialist
sharedRules.description: The Squadron chosen may choose to make a free Flat Out Movement Action during the Recon Phase provided the move does not bring the Element within 16" of an enemy Model at any time during its movement.

sharedRules.name: Robust
sharedRules.description: Unlike other Aquan Armoured elements, this element does not lose Sectored Armour MAR when they gain a damage marker.

sharedRules.name: Sectored_Armour
sharedRules.description: Model never suffers penalties to DR from Flank or Aft Main Ordnance attacks.

sharedRules.name: Sky_Drop
sharedRules.description: May use the Sky Drop Deployment rules on Page 79.

sharedRules.name: Sky_Drop_Asset
sharedRules.description: This squadron MUST deploy via Sky Drop (Page 79 of Core Rulebook)

sharedRules.name: Sky_Drop_Nexus(2)
sharedRules.description: Places 2 Drop Site Markers in the Place Drop-Sites Segment of the Pre-Game Phase.

sharedRules.name: Strafing_Run
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may initiate a CQB Attack during its own activation while moving Flat Out provided the target squadron are Surface Models. These shots are considered to be Rushed.

sharedRules.name: Take_&_Hold
sharedRules.description: This unit may claim objectives.

sharedRules.name: Target_Lock
sharedRules.description: May use Nexus Designator to target an enemy unit befor the rest of the unit fires Main Ordnance. 0-3 hits : No Effect. 4+ Hits : Firing Squadron gains a placed bonus when firing their Main Ordnance.

sharedRules.name: Thunderous_Charge
sharedRules.description: The Leviathan may perform a Leviathan CQB Action after moving Flat Out.

sharedRules.name: Transport(10)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for 10 slots worth of Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Transport(16)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for 16 slots worth of Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Transport(6)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for 6 slots worth of Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Votari_Focal_Point
sharedRules.description: When fired upon by friendly Aquan Beam Weaponry, all attacks are treated as Placed prior to normal modifications

sharedRules.name: Walker
sharedRules.description: May not move Flat Out through Vegation or Rivers.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Anti-Personnel
sharedRules.description: Weapon ignores Hard Target rules when targeting Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Corrosive
sharedRules.description: Models damaged by this weapon, but not destroyed receive a Debilitating Effect Marker. These markets give -1 DR until repaired. Multiple Markers may be placed, but the effect is not cumulative.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Interceptor
sharedRules.description: Flying targets do not gain the benefit of Hard Target against these weapons.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Nexus Designator
sharedRules.description: Weapon is used to reduce Sky Drop Markers micro dice.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Pinpoint(1)
sharedRules.description: If a Pinpoint weapon damages, but fails to destroy non-infantry, roll 1d6. If a 6 is rolled, the target suffers an additional point of damage. If multiple weapons combine with Pinpoint, use the highest value only.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Pinpoint(2)
sharedRules.description: If a Pinpoint weapon damages, but fails to destroy non-infantry, roll 2d6. If one or more 6's are rolled, the target suffers an additional point of damage. If multiple weapons combine with Pinpoint, use the highest value only.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Pinpoint(3)
sharedRules.description: If a Pinpoint weapon damages, but fails to destroy non-infantry, roll 3d6. If one or more 6's are rolled, the target suffers an additional point of damage. If multiple weapons combine with Pinpoint, use the highest value only.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Pinpoint(4)
sharedRules.description: If a Pinpoint weapon damages, but fails to destroy non-infantry, roll 4d6. If one or more 6's are rolled, the target suffers an additional point of damage. If multiple weapons combine with Pinpoint, use the highest value only.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Scatter
sharedRules.description: Scatter Weapons ignore any negative modifiers from the Hard Taret MAR when firing at non-flying Targets.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Terror Weapon
sharedRules.description: Disorder Tests caused by this weapon roll one less die.
